chunks: 'Ali, from his father, from some of his companions, from Abi al-Sabbah al-Kinani, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever commits an offense in the Ka'bah is killed.

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka'bah, the sacred House in Makkah
key_terms.حَدَثًا: an act of offense or violation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on someone who commits an offense in the Ka'bah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning one who commits a grave offense within the sanctuary of the Ka'bah. It reflects the severe sanctity of the sacred precinct and the seriousness of violating its inviolability.
